label: August 17–23, 2026
intro: BICT Fest opens Thursday August 21 — 11 participatory shows from 9 countries at One Bangkok. Catch Character Fest's final day Sunday Aug 17 to start the week, then pivot to world-class children's theatre for the rest of it.

activities.title: BICT Fest 2026 — Opening Weekend
activities.date: Thursday August 21 – Sunday August 23 (festival runs Aug 21–30)
activities.location: One Bangkok Park (primary venue) + Goethe-Institut Thailand + Sodsai Centre, Chulalongkorn Univ.
activities.price: Free programmes + ticketed shows on Eventpop
activities.why: 10th anniversary BICT Fest: 11 interactive performances by artists from 9 countries (South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Belgium, France, UK, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand). Theme: 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' Thor won't just watch — he'll be part of the action. Highlights include IYKYK (light & shadow worlds by Thai multimedia collective DuckUnit) and Plock! (Belgian circus performers who paint with their bodies à la Jackson Pollock). Rare, world-class kids programme.
activities.tip: Book FREE programme slots at bictfest.com NOW — they go first. Opening weekend Thursday–Sunday has the most energy and most shows. Wear comfortable shoes; shows move between outdoor spaces at One Bangkok Park.

activities.title: Character Fest Thailand 2 — Final Day
activities.date: Sunday August 17 (closing day of the festival)
activities.location: CentralWorld, Level 1 — Beacon Zone, Central Court & Eden Zone (Chit Lom BTS)
activities.why: Last chance to catch Character Fest before it closes. Pop culture characters, interactive experiences, and exclusive merchandise. If Thor missed the opening weekend, Sunday August 17 is the final shot. Free entry — zero risk.
activities.tip: Closing day energy can be festive with final performances. Arrive mid-morning before it gets crowded.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: A hands-on Saturday morning ceramic session pairs perfectly with an afternoon BICT Fest show — morning making, afternoon watching performers from around the world. Thor gets a full creative day.
activities.tip: Book a few days ahead. Saturday morning + BICT Fest afternoon is the ultimate combination weekend.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Early Week Session
activities.date: Monday–Wednesday August 17–19 (before BICT Fest opens Thursday)
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; skate rental included
activities.why: A quick weekday ice session early in the week before BICT Fest takes over Thursday–Sunday. Quiet, cheap, and keeps Thor's ice skills sharp going into a busy weekend.
activities.tip: Monday–Wednesday slots are the emptiest of the week. Treat it as a quick 90-minute outing, then grab food at the Ekkamai street market nearby.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skates + protective gear included
activities.why: A good Saturday warm-up before BICT Fest — Emporium to One Bangkok is easy by BTS (Phrom Phong → Chong Nonsi area). Keeps Thor's rollerblading momentum going during a busy festival week.
activities.tip: Sunday morning 10–11am is quietest. Pair with lunch at Emporium food court before heading to One Bangkok.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.location: Mega Bangna, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.why: If Thor hasn't done the Marvel Experience yet, a quiet mid-week day before BICT Fest opens is the perfect window. Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets. He'll be talking about it through the festival.
activities.tip: Tuesday or Wednesday at Mega Bangna is quietest. Book on Klook for the best price. Allow 2 hours.
